title: Before the Choice: An Evidential Framework for Studying Prospective Representations in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An observable decision reveals the selected action but does not determine which alternatives were internally represented. Drawing on prospection research and hippocampal forward-sweep observations, we develop Before the Choice, an evidence-oriented framework distinguishing future-directed content, prospective computation, and causal guidance. The framework organizes four experimental contrasts and makes their alternative explanations explicit. Its first test case concerns unchosen trajectories in deterministic symbolic environments. A preregistered low-rank probe evaluated once on a sealed TEST did not meet its criterion (paired accuracy 0.020 versus 0.195 for a text-and-observed-choice baseline; 293 admissible pairs). Exploratory H1b exposed a reconstruction-by-elimination problem: identifying the chosen candidate can determine the unchosen target. In H1c, matched worlds varied an unchosen continuation while keeping candidate keys bit

translated_title: 选择之前：研究语言模型中前瞻性表征的证据框架
translated_abstract: 一个可观察的决策揭示了被选中的行动，但并不能确定内部表征了哪些备选方案。借鉴前瞻性研究与海马体前向扫掠的观测，我们提出了“选择之前”，一个面向证据的框架，用以区分面向未来的内容、前瞻性计算与因果引导。该框架组织了四组实验对比，并使其替代解释变得明确。其首个测试案例关注确定性符号环境中的未被选择轨迹。一项预注册的低秩探针在密封测试集上仅评估一次，未达到其预设标准（配对准确率为0.020，而基于文本与观测选择的基线为0.195；共293个有效配对）。探索性假设H1b揭示了“排除法重构”问题：识别出被选中的候选即可能确定未被选择的目标。在H1c中，匹配世界在保持候选键位级相同的同时改变未被选择的延续……
tldr: 该论文提出“选择之前”这一证据导向框架，区分前瞻性内容、前瞻性计算与因果引导，用以检验语言模型是否内部表征未被选择的轨迹，并通过预注册探针实验发现低秩探针未达标且存在排除法重构的混淆问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Before the Choice," an evidence-oriented framework distinguishing future-directed content, prospective computation, and causal guidance, and uses preregistered probing experiments to test whether language models internally represent unchosen trajectories—finding that probes fail the criterion and that reconstruction-by-elimination poses a key confound.
